decisions.text: groups laid out first, largest first, then each group's parts, squarified, the largest at the top left (G7.34); gaps of 1 pt, 2.5 pt between groups
each group in its own colour, in the order of the groups, its name in bold at its top left: Europe series-1, Asia series-2, N. America series-3, Africa series-4, Oceania series-5, S. America series-6
28 of 100 tiles named inside, at the bottom left; 6 shortened with “…”; 72 too small to name, counted in a note (a static chart has no tooltips) (G7.34)

source.shows: the same hundred parts in a hierarchy: the continents laid out first, largest first, each in its own colour with its name in bold at its top left, the countries inside (R7-16, G7.34); the book's continent colours are arbitrary, so the palette's order stands; the plot three quarters as high as wide, near the book's (an open choice)
